finding: `npm run validate:standard -- --json` can exceed 30 minutes without emitting a bounded terminal summary or a clearly discoverable run id for the timed-out invocation.
expectedBehavior: Long validator profiles should always emit progress, run id, currently running validator, failed validator summary, and a resume/status command before or at timeout. Evidence capture should never need another manual forensic pass to identify the blocking validator set.
evidenceOrRepro: During ATM-GOV-0245 close evidence refresh, `node atm.mjs evidence run --command "npm run validate:standard -- --json"` timed out after about 1,804 seconds with no JSON summary. `.atm/runtime/validator-runs/atm-gov-0245-standard/summary.partial.json` later showed 13 failed validators and one running validator.
followUp: Make run-validators/evidence-run cooperate on heartbeat output, terminal timeout envelopes, and automatic status artifact attachment for long profiles.
